risks.risk: Wrong size/model (86-inch and the exact LG model may not match; pricing depends heavily on exact model/year).
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the TV’s rear label (model number/serial) or the Settings > About screen showing model and size.
risks.if_unproven: Price as the worst-case among plausible sizes/models shown only as an LG smart TV (not guaranteed 86-inch / not guaranteed the stated model).

risks.risk: Panel issues not visible in these photos (dead pixels, backlight uniformity, burn-in, lines).
risks.proof: Video clip showing: solid color screens (red/green/blue/white/black) and a scrolling text/gradient test, plus a close-up of any uniformity areas.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully guaranteed (assume possible panel defects) until tested.

risks.risk: Audio/ports/remote issues (soundbar/box may be masking TV speaker problems; HDMI/USB may be faulty).
risks.proof: Short video of TV menu + testing at least 2 HDMI ports and one USB playback; show remote working (channel/app navigation).
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst-case: assume some connectivity/remote issues until proven.

risks.risk: Accessories/stand/wall-mount completeness (stand, remote, power cable, original box may be missing).
risks.proof: Photo of everything included laid out (remote, stand parts, power cable, wall mount if any) and a shot of the TV with stand attached.
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete package (missing remote/stand not included) until confirmed.

proof_requests: Clear rear label photo showing exact model number and serial (or Settings > About showing model/size).
Settings > Picture/Resolution (or About) screen showing UHD/4K confirmation.
Video test: solid colors + gradient + no lines/dead pixels.
Video test of HDMI ports (at least 2) and remote navigation.
Photo of included items: remote, stand/wall mount parts, power cable, and any accessories.
